text:
Jordan: quick brain dump — comparing two ways to show spend: a timeline (area/stacked) vs a heatmap grid by project x day. Tradeoffs?
Maria: timeline = great for trends and forecasting, heatmap = fast hotspot detection across many projects.
AJ: +1. timeline helps with token-rate anomalies (sudden spike), heatmap surfaces consistently expensive projects.
Samir: question about token breakdown — do we show prompt/comp/embedding per row or condensed? heatmap could color by total and tooltip shows breakdown.
Kevin: accessibility nit — ensure heatmap uses colorblind-safe palette and has an accessible textual summary for screen readers.
Emily: invoice/receipt alignment: people expect the invoice link near the org header, not buried in a right rail. If we surface invoices per-line in a timeline, might confuse legal teams.
Jordan: action: prototype both. timeline with stacked bands for token types + small multiples per project; heatmap with project rows and day columns, click cell -> panel with token breakdown + download invoice button.
Maria: mobile: timeline collapses to sparkline, heatmap becomes list with colored labels. Need to mock how tooltips map on touch.
AJ: performance question: heatmap with 200 projects x 90 days — rendering and interaction cost. We should sample or allow adjustable window.
Samir: UX copy: 'Cost by project' vs 'Spend by workspace' — which is clearer for org-admins? Recommend 'Spend by project (workspace)' and show org-level toggle.
Kevin: contrast example for heatmap — avoid pure red/green; propose palette: #084B8A -> #F2B138, with patterns for low contrast situations. Also add aria-label summary: "Heatmap: highest spend projects are X, Y over last 30 days".
Emily: invoices: add 'Download CSV' on the breakdown panel and a persistence note: "This invoice reflects charges billed to your org billing account." small copy tweak to avoid confusion for projects with separate billing.
Jordan: design-bot posted mock link: https://figma.redwood/proto/spend-heatmap — take a look.
design-bot: prototype update: added hover state, accessible summary, and a compact legend.
Maria: tiny copy tweak for timeline tooltip: replace 'tokens' with 'estimated tokens' when we apply sampling/estimates.
AJ: can we add a small 'confidence' indicator when sampling is used? e.g., ⚠️ Low confidence if <90% coverage.
Samir: edge case: orgs with multiple billing accounts — we need a clear switcher at top to pick billing account; default to org-wide rollup with per-account tabs.
Kevin: checklist for handoff: color palette tokens, aria summaries for both views, keyboard focus states, and QR for mobile interactions.
Emily: can we add a short empty state for new orgs: 'No spend yet — try generating an API key or view sample data' with CTA.
Jordan: agreed. I'll collect all these and schedule a 30-min review tomorrow 10am PT. Owners: Maria (heatmap), AJ (timeline), Samir (copy & accessibility), Emily (invoices).
Maria: noted. I'll upload updated frames before review.
AJ: I'll add the confidence indicator and a performance note.
Samir: I'll draft the accessibility summary copy and share a voiceover test.
Kevin: will run color contrast checks on the uploaded frames.
Emily: tagging billing eng to confirm invoice download flow: @billing-team FYI.
Jordan: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
